info.description: API for the Horpug dormitory management system.
info.title: Horpug API

get.summary: Get an activity log by ID

post.summary: Log in with username/email and password
Exchange the refresh token cookie for a new access/refresh token pair

get.description: Returns every contract for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only contracts under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by tenant, room, dormitory or status.

post.description: Creates a lease contract linking a tenant to a room. A room may only have one active contract at a time.

get.description: Returns every dormitory for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only the dormitories the caller manages.

Returns active dormitories for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only the active dormitories the caller manages. Intended for populating dormitory selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.

Returns every invoice for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only invoices under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by contract, room, dormitory, tenant, status or billing period.

parameters.description: Filter by status (unpaid, paid, overdue, cancelled)
parameters.name: status

post.description: Builds an invoice from the contract's rent price plus any electricity/water meter readings recorded for the contract's room within the given period_year/period_month, each stored as a line item.
post.summary: Create an invoice for a contract's billing period

put.summary: Update an invoice's status, due date or note

get.description: Returns every meter reading for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only readings under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by room or dormitory.

post.description: Records a meter reading or charge for a room. billing_method "metered" (default) derives total_amount as (current_unit - previous_unit) * price_per_unit; billing_method "flat" uses flat_amount directly as total_amount, for flat-rate, tiered or shared-meter charges computed externally.

get.summary: Get a meter reading by ID

get.description: Returns every payment for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only payments under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by invoice, contract, room, dormitory, tenant or payment date range.

post.description: Records a payment for an invoice. Once the invoice's recorded payments reach its total_amount, the invoice is automatically marked paid.
post.summary: Record a payment against an invoice

delete.description: Deletes a payment and re-evaluates the invoice's paid status accordingly.

get.description: Returns active roles. Intended for populating role selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.
Returns every room type for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only room types under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by dormitory.

Returns active room types for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only the active room types under dormitories the caller manages. Intended for populating room type selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.

get.summary: Get a room type by ID

get.description: Returns every room for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only rooms under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by dormitory.

Returns active rooms for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only the active rooms under dormitories the caller manages. Intended for populating room selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.

parameters.description: Filter by room number or dormitory name
parameters.name: q

get.description: Returns active tenants. Intended for populating tenant selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.

parameters.description: Filter by name, phone or id card
parameters.name: q

get.description: Returns active users. Intended for populating user selectors; results are capped rather than paginated.
Returns every water meter reading for roles with full dormitory access, otherwise only readings under dormitories the caller manages. Optionally filter by room or dormitory.

post.description: Records a water meter reading or charge for a room. billing_method "metered" (default) derives total_amount as (current_unit - previous_unit) * price_per_unit; billing_method "flat" uses flat_amount directly as total_amount, for flat-rate, tiered or shared-meter charges computed externally.

get.summary: Get a water meter reading by ID

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and the JWT token.
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
